We have confused unbalanced trade with free trade. FREE trade balances through currency. I GET the libertarian argument. I was trained at the cathedral of it (Wharton). Everything moves in cycles. Intrusive and abusive government is a symptom of a fraying society. And to directly address the observation, yes we are a wealthy country (albeit less so on a relative basis than 50 and 100 years ago) and we benefit from trade. It’s not that other countries have “stolen” from us.
